results.note: Hucbald's Adnotationes: No English translation found in scholarly sources or online databases.
Hucbald's Commentarius historicus de S. Jonato: No English translation found despite searching academic and medieval studies resources.
De harmonica institutione: English translation by Warren Babb in 'Hucbald, Guido, and John on Music: Three Medieval Treatises' (Yale University Press, Music Theory Translation Series, 1978).

De tonis et psalmis modulandis (also titled Commemoratio brevis de tonis et psalmis modulandis): Search results indicate a critical edition and translation by University of Ottawa Press, but details unclear; attribution to Hucbald is also questioned in scholarship.
De translationibus et miraculis S. Rictrudis: No English translation found; only Latin texts available in scholarly collections.
Eclogia: No translation found for this work. Note: A related work 'Ecloga de Calvis' has an English translation by Thomas Klein (Comitatus journal, 1995), but unclear if this is the same work.
Epistola de S. Theoderico: No English translation found in online or scholarly sources.
Epistola metrica: No English translation found.
Epitaphium Milonis: No English translation found.
Epitaphium: No English translation found.
Hymnus de S. Theoderico: No English translation found.

Musica enchiriadis: English translation by Raymond Erickson, 'Musica enchiriadis and Scolica enchiriadis' (Yale University Press, Music Theory Translation Series, 1995). Note: This work is anonymous 9th-century, not by Hucbald despite traditional PL attribution.
Passio SS. Quirici et Julittae: No English translation found despite searching medieval hagiography sources.

Scholia enchiriadis (also called Scolica enchiriadis): English translation by Raymond Erickson, 'Musica enchiriadis and Scolica enchiriadis' (Yale University Press, Music Theory Translation Series, 1995). Note: This is an anonymous 9th-century work, not by Hucbald.
Vita S. Aldegundis: No English translation found; only Latin text available on Wikisource and similar repositories.
Vita S. Lebwini: No English translation found; only Latin text available on Wikisource.
Vita S. Rictrudis: No English translation found.
Commentarius in Matthaeum: Complete English translation by D. H. Williams (Catholic University of America Press, 2013), published for the first time in English as a scholarly translation.

Commentarius in psalmos XV XXXI XLI: Psalm commentary specimens translated by E. W. Watson et al. in NPNF Series II, Volume 9 (1899). Full Tractatus super Psalmos also has specimens/homilies in same volume.
Apologetica responsa ad reprehensores libri de synodis: English translation by E. W. Watson, L. Pullan, K. Knight in NPNF Series II, Volume 9 (1899).
De Trinitate: Complete English translation by E. W. Watson, L. Pullan, K. Knight in NPNF Series II, Volume 9 (1899). Also available through CCEL and Catholic Library.
Epistola ad Abram: Likely included in NPNF Series II, Volume 9, but no specific confirmation found of its separate translation status.

Epistola seu libellus: English translation by Lionel Wickham in 'Hilary of Poitiers: Conflicts of Conscience and Law in the Fourth-Century Church' (Liverpool University Press, Translated Texts for Historians series, 1997).

Fragmenta ex opere historico: Partial translation by P. Smulders (1995) of preface mentioned in scholarship. Fragments may be included in TTH/NPNF editions, but no complete English translation clearly identified.
Hymnus Abrae missus: No specific translation found; may be part of larger NPNF collection but not confirmed.
Liber contra Arianos vel Auxentium: No specific English translation found despite searching scholarly sources and NPNF contents.

Liber contra Constantium: English translation by Lionel Wickham in 'Hilary of Poitiers: Conflicts of Conscience and Law in the Fourth-Century Church' (Liverpool University Press, Translated Texts for Historians series, 1997).
Liber de synodis seu fide orientalium: English translation titled 'On the Councils' by E. W. Watson, L. Pullan, K. Knight in NPNF Series II, Volume 9 (1899).
Liber primus ad Constantium Augustum: Possibly part of Liber contra Constantium (Lionel Wickham translation), but separate status unclear.
Liber secundus ad Constantium: Possibly part of Liber contra Constantium (Lionel Wickham translation), but separate status unclear.
Sermo de dedicatione ecclesiae: No English translation found; only Latin texts available in scholarly sources and Documenta Catholica Omnia.
Fragmenta ex aliis operibus: Likely included in NPNF Series II, Volume 9, but no specific separate confirmation of translation status found.
Tractatus super psalmos: Psalm commentary with specimens and homilies translated by E. W. Watson et al. in NPNF Series II, Volume 9 (1899). Titled 'Homilies on Psalms I., LIII., CXXX.'
